name: sooodreamy-remotion
description: SooDreamy Kino-Prolog — textfreie Papier&Licht-Videoszenen, in CI gerendert, nie committet. FullRelease N1-C.

scripts.remux:hvc1: for f in out/*.mp4; do npx remotion ffmpeg -v error -y -i "$f" -c copy -tag:v hvc1 "${f%.mp4}.hvc1.mp4" && mv "${f%.mp4}.hvc1.mp4" "$f"; done
scripts.render:all: npm run render:scene2 && npm run render:scene3 && npm run render:scene6
